table.name: TLGNC_WAGON_EVENT
table.description: Contains all status update events regarding wagons received from SBB.

column.name: WAGON_EVENT_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_wagon_event_status. Indicates the processing status.

column.name: INTERCHANGE_CONTROL_REFERENCE
column.description: Unique reference assigned by sender in order to be able to relate this row to an EDIFACT interchange. See also EDIFACT UNB 0020.

column.name: MESSAGE_REFERENCE_NO
column.description: Unique reference assigned by sender in order to be able to relate this row to an EDIFACT message within an interchange. See also EDIFACT UNH 0062.

column.name: EVENT_TYPE
column.description: Status. 1 = ohne Tk-Aufbau oder auf BLOCK ohne Zerlegeende, 2 = Tk ist aufgebaut, 3 = Abgangskontrolle erfolgt, 5 = Abgesetellt, ausgesetzt, 6 = Zollrevision, 8 = Eingangskontrolle erfolgt, 9 = RIV-Uebergabe erfolgt

column.name: CUR_RAILWAY_STATION
column.description: Train station at time of the event. Format: n2(UicBahn) + n6(Bhfnr).

column.name: DEP_RAILWAY_STATION
column.description: Train station from which the shipment is sent. Format: n2(UicBahn) + n6(Bhfnr).

column.name: DEST_RAILWAY_STATION
column.description: Train station to which the shipment is delivered. Format: n2(UicBahn) + n6(Bhfnr).

column.name: NEXT_RAILWAY_STATION
column.description: Next handling train station. Format: n2(UicBahn) + n6(Bhfnr).
